caption_used: 该折线图展示了lattice、FLAT与OURS三种方法在训练过程中F1分数的演变趋势。横轴为训练轮数（epoch），范围从0到18；纵轴为F1分数，范围从0.55至0.90。红色实线带方形标记代表lattice方法，初始F1值约为0.59，在epoch=16时达到约0.85。蓝色实线带圆形标记代表FLAT方法，起始F1值约为0.79，收敛速度较快。黄色实线带三角形标记代表OURS方法，初始F1值约为0.82，最终在epoch=16达到约0.90。值得注意的是，FLAT方法在epoch=8附近即超越OURS，两者在中间阶段表现接近，而lattice方法虽起步较慢但在后期展现出与FLAT相当的增长速率。
raw_response:
The figure is a line chart illustrating the evolution of F1 scores for three methods – lattice, FLAT, and OURS – during the training process. The chart compares the F1 scores of these methods as a function of the number of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch (次)", ranges from 0 to 18, with evenly spaced numerical intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "F1分数", ranges from approximately 0.55 to 0.90, with intervals of 0.05. The red line, represented by square markers, corresponds to the lattice method, starting at an F1 value of approximately 0.59 and reaching a value of approximately 0.85 at epoch 16. The blue line, marked with circular markers, represents the FLAT method, beginning with an F1 value of approximately 0.79 and converging relatively quickly. The yellow line, depicted with triangular markers, represents the OURS method, starting at an F1 value of approximately 0.82 and reaching a value of approximately 0.90 at epoch 16.

The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 18, with increments of 2. The y-axis represents the F1 score, ranging from approximately 0.55 to 0.90, with increments of 0.05. The lattice method begins with an F1 score of approximately 0.59 and reaches a peak of approximately 0.85 at epoch 16. The FLAT method starts with an F1 score of approximately 0.79 and converges relatively quickly. The OURS method begins with an F1 score of approximately 0.82 and reaches a value of approximately 0.90 at epoch 16.
